name: Paying Tithes
overview: Scripture reveals that paying tithes is a sacred act of honoring God by giving a tenth of one’s increase, as seen in the command to tithe the land’s produce year by year (Deuteronomy 14:22) and the declaration that the tithe is holy to the LORD (Leviticus 27:30). Tithing is also an expression of recognizing God's provision and sovereignty, exemplified by Abraham giving tithes to the Most High God after victory (Genesis 14:20) and the instruction to honor the LORD with the firstfruits of all increase (Proverbs 3:9). Furthermore, tithes supported the Levites in their service to God’s tabernacle (Numbers 18:21), emphasizing the tithes’ role in sustaining God’s work. The rebuke in Malachi 3:8 highlights the seriousness of withholding tithes, framing it as robbing God, which underscores the believer’s responsibility to faithfully return what belongs to Him.
